## Rationale

The user chose this. The dashboard is read-only, so the fastest way to act on a gate is to paste a prompt into the agent chat; c is the copy key users already know, and the focused panel decides what it copies.

## Counter-argument

One key with two meanings depending on focus is easy to misfire; a separate y key always does the same thing.

payload.alternatives: keep c as copy-subject and add y for the prompt; better labels with no prompt copying
payload.choice: Needs you rows lead with an action verb, and c on a Needs you item copies a ready agent prompt; c on a task row still copies the slug

record.subject: needs-you-copy-prompt
